comparison.objective: Hold a pin in digital-caliper jaws and obtain an accurate, low-force diameter measurement; candidate tunes and locks an impact damper for repeatable carriage stopping.
comparison.physical_skill: Caliper task requires loose bimanual part support, squareness, gentle jaw closure, and avoiding measurement preload. Candidate requires recessed-key engagement, fastener loosening, collar adjustment, counterholding, tightening, and dynamic-response iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Caliper success depends on pin pose, reading error down to 0.05 mm, alignment within 1°, and jaw force at most 0.3 N. Candidate depends on two safe impact cycles, ≤12 mm travel, no hard-stop contact or excessive rebound, and bounded post-lock drift.
comparison.reason: Both involve force sensitivity, but one evaluates precision metrology while the other evaluates mechanical adjustment retention and dynamic damping.
